name: David

battleDialogue.onEncounter: I see you made it to my class in time.|I hope you are ready to learn some math.|I have a lot to teach you, so let's get started.|Prepare to turn whatever you learned in C# into pratcial math skills.|I will be testing you on your knowledge of shapes, curves, and layers.|I hope you are ready to learn some math.
onAttack: You can't brute force your way through a proof.
Violence is not a valid step in the derivation.
Show your work. I'm not marking that.
onAct: Everything in a game is math.|Movement, collision, the curve on a jump.|My lessons should be translated into your work in Unity.
Students think geometry is decoration.|Then they wonder why their hitboxes feel wrong.
A hexagon tiles the plane with the least perimeter per area.|Nature worked that out before either of us did.
You're not bad at this.|You're just impatient.
Numbers don't care how you feel about them.|That's the nicest thing about them.
I once tried to invert a matrix on a first date.|We did not have a second date.
A vector has direction and magnitude.|My GPS has neither, and somehow we still get places.
The dot product of two vectors can be zero.|So can my raise this year. We call both of them 'orthogonal to reality.'
The cross product needs exactly three dimensions to work.|My apartment has two, and a lot of regrets.
Every point on a circle is the same distance from the center.|Unlike my students, who all sit as far from the front as legally possible.
onSpare: Mercy isn't a theorem. You can't prove it to me.
battleDialogue.onDefeat: Hm.|You found the shorter proof.|I've been doing it the long way for years....
battleDialogue.onSpared: You had the win and you didn't take it.|That's not a mistake. That's a choice.|Go on. The next door is yours.

moves.description: David puts the song on and teaches the whole lesson at once.
moves.intro: You've been patient with me. I'll return the favour.|Everything I've taught you was one idea at a time.|Shapes. Layers. Curves.|That was the courtesy.|Now let's see you hold all of it at once.

descriptionByHp.text: David - HP 48, ATK 4. Teaches math at Tiltan.|Somehow weaker than Yakir? Who designed this game?|Ah wait, David's damage is doubled against students.|Good job game designer!.
